name: cgroup_guardian
description: Flowork Sovereign Cgroup v2 Quarantine and Kernel Sentinel Guardian. Monitor Kernel PSI (Pressure Stall Information), freeze runaway processes instantly, throttle CPU priorities, and verify critical binary integrity.

action.description: Action to perform: 'status' to inspect cgroup & PSI, 'quarantine' to freeze a runaway PID, 'release' to unfreeze, 'verify_binaries' to check ELF integrity, 'test_simulation' to run a live test.

pid.description: Target process ID for quarantine or release.

reason.description: Reason for quarantine (e.g. 'Memory leak detected', 'Runaway loop').
